title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-k1jp: responder passes plaintext instead of CIPHERTEXT_3 to transcript_4
description:
In `EdhocInitiator::finish_process_message_3()` at edhoc.rs line ~1345, the responder calls `transcript_4(&self.state.th_3, &pending.plaintext, peer.credential)`. Per RFC 9528 §3.9, TH_4 = H(TH_3, CIPHERTEXT_3, CRED_I), where CIPHERTEXT_3 is the encrypted ciphertext from message_3 (not the decrypted plaintext). The initiator correctly passes `&ciphertext_3.0` (the encrypted bytes). The responder decrypts message_3 and passes the decrypted output, causing a TH_4 mismatch between initiator and responder, which breaks OSCORE key derivation.

The fix: store the raw ciphertext from message_3 in `PendingMessage3` (or access it from `msg3` parameter before decryption) and pass that to `transcript_4` instead of `pending.plaintext`.

This is a pre-existing bug discovered during directory-level review of commit project-LICHEN-worker6-k1jp. The commit itself correctly adds the `cred` parameter to `transcript_4` and fixes the initiator side.
